title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional study nooks, quiet lounges, and specialized labs that Brandeis students use to navigate their academic and social lives beyond the standard admissions route.

cards.title: Farber Mezzanine Study Area
cards.subtitle: Above the Starbucks in Farber Library
cards.notes: Head up the stairs from the library Starbucks to find collaborative stations and team-spot desks ideal for group work with a social buzz.
cards.short_summary: A social, collaborative study level located directly above the campus Starbucks in Farber Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Farber Mezzanine contains collaborative stations and group study rooms and is located one floor above the Farber 1 Starbucks.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; accessible via stairs or elevator from the Farber 1 entrance.

cards.title: The Quiet Floor
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Goldfarb Library
cards.notes: Retreat to the lowest level of Goldfarb for absolute silence; this floor is strictly designated for individual, distraction-free study.
cards.short_summary: The designated quietest floor in the library system, located two levels below the main entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Goldfarb 3 is officially designated as a quiet floor and houses study carrels for individual work.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the main Goldfarb entrance; follow signs for Level 3.

cards.title: Mandel Center Roof Garden
cards.subtitle: Top floor of the Mandel Center for the Humanities
cards.notes: Visit the fourth floor to access the roof garden, a peaceful outdoor space for reading or quiet reflection with views of the campus.
cards.short_summary: An elevated outdoor garden space located on the top floor of the humanities center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mandel Center for the Humanities features a roof garden accessible to the campus community.
cards.source_title: A Center of Attention | Brandeis Magazine
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; take the elevator to the 4th floor.

cards.title: SCC Quiet Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Shapiro Campus Center Upper Floor
cards.notes: Use the MacBooks and individual desks in this sun-drenched lab for a quiet alternative to the often-busy main SCC atrium.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, window-lined computer lab on the upper level of the Shapiro Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The upper level of the Shapiro Campus Center features a computer lab with MacBooks and desks for quiet study.
cards.source_title: Andy's Best Study Spaces, Part 1 | The Heller School
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24 hours with a valid Brandeis ID card.

cards.title: Heller Breakout Rooms
cards.subtitle: Ground floor of the Heller-Schneider Building
cards.notes: Claim a first-come, first-served breakout room for private group meetings or focused individual work; each room includes a TV and chargers.
cards.short_summary: Private, tech-equipped rooms on the ground floor of the Heller School used for group study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Heller-Schneider building ground floor has several breakout rooms available for student use on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: On Campus Study Spots | The Heller School
cards.access_notes: Available to all students; rooms are first-come, first-served unless reserved for academic sessions.

cards.title: Gerstenzang Grad Lounge
cards.subtitle: Main floor of Gerstenzang Science Library
cards.notes: Relax in this casual lounge featuring a small kitchen, complimentary snacks, and sofas; it's a social hub for the science community.
cards.short_summary: A social lounge for graduate students located within the Gerstenzang Science Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gerstenzang Graduate Student Center provides a place to relax, socialize, and study with complimentary snacks.
cards.source_title: Spaces for Graduate Students | Brandeis University
cards.access_notes: Primarily for graduate students; located on the main floor of the science library.

cards.title: Slosberg Music Practice Rooms
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Slosberg Music Center
cards.notes: Find a private room with a grand piano on the lower level; these are open to all Brandeis community members for practice.
cards.short_summary: Individual music practice rooms equipped with grand pianos, open to the entire campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Slosberg Music Center has practice rooms on the lower level open to all members of the Brandeis community on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; first-come, first-served for the general community.

cards.title: Shapiro Science Atrium
cards.subtitle: Main entrance of the Shapiro Science Center
cards.notes: Study in the bright, modern atrium overlooking campus; it offers ample seating and a professional atmosphere for science students.
cards.short_summary: A large, sunlit atrium with dedicated study spaces within the university's main science complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shapiro Science Center features an atrium with study space and seminar areas.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; accessible to all students.

cards.title: Kutz Hall Grad Center
cards.subtitle: First floor of Kutz Hall
cards.notes: Utilize the computers, scanners, and kitchen facilities in this dedicated grad space; it's a prime spot for social events and late-night work.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive resource center for graduate students featuring study equipment and social spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Graduate Student Center in Kutz Hall includes computers, scanners, a refrigerator, and free snacks for graduate students.
cards.source_title: A grad student's guide to the best study spots at Brandeis
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of Kutz Hall; primarily serves the graduate student population.

cards.title: Judaica Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Goldfarb Library Mezzanine
cards.notes: Find a quiet, traditional academic atmosphere in this specialized reading room; note that power outlets are limited here.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, specialized reading room on the mezzanine level of Goldfarb Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Goldfarb Mezzanine houses the Judaica Reading Room, which is used for quiet study.
cards.source_title: A Comprehensive Guide to Brandeis Study Spaces | Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Located on the Goldfarb Mezzanine; accessible via the main library entrance.
